detail.longDescription:
Zapia is the AI assistant that gets things done for you. It automates your WhatsApp, organizes your calendar, answers your emails, and compares prices. All the power of advanced AI, but easy to use and secure. No setup needed. 

Just chat or send an audio.

Over 1 million people already use Zapia. ⭐ 4.8

WHATSAPP — YOUR BIGGEST ADVANTAGE
Automate your WhatsApp: summarize chats, schedule messages and replies, and transcribe your voice notes. Zapia messages businesses, vendors, and restaurants for you to get quotes, book, or negotiate.

BUILD YOUR TEAM OF SPECIALIZED AGENTS
Add agents for every area of your life, no code and no complex setup:
• Finance Agent: tracks spending, budgets, and alerts
• WhatsApp Agent: automates messages and contacts
• Nutrition Agent: meal plans and tracking
• Travel Agent, Shopping Agent, and many more
Each one works for you in the background.

CALENDAR & REMINDERS
Create, view, and edit Google Calendar events with a message. One-time or recurring reminders. Daily summary of your schedule plus weather, news, and price alerts.

EMAIL
Read and summarize your Gmail or Outlook inbox. Draft and send emails for you. Notify participants of changes or delays.

PRICES & SHOPPING
Compare prices on Amazon and more. Track products and get alerts when prices drop. Build lists and carts in your favorite shopping and delivery apps.

RESTAURANTS & TRAVEL
Find the best restaurants near you and book a table at your favorite spots. Search flights and compare prices across platforms.

AND MORE
Read and summarize PDFs, analyze photos, transcribe voice notes. Radar: Zapia works in the background and pings you when it finds a way to help. Responds in English, Spanish, and Portuguese, and learns your preferences.

CONNECT YOUR APPS
Connect your favorite apps with our official connectors, or ask Zapia to connect the services you use: WhatsApp, Gmail, Google Calendar, Drive, Outlook, Tasks, and Contacts.

Zapia Pro and Ultra: more scheduled tasks and better AI models.
